editorial:
Imagine taking a romantic trip to Italy with your partner, only to have your worst childhood nightmares show up in real life. That is exactly what happens to Daniel and Clara. While they are exploring the beautiful scenery, a creepy figure called the Sandman starts following Daniel. At the same time, Daniel falls head over heels for a woman named Olympia. She is stunning, but there is something off about her. The movie feels like a dark dream where you are not quite sure what is real and what is just in Daniel's head, making the whole experience feel uneasy and mysterious.

You will love how the tension builds up, though the pacing starts a bit slow. The acting is solid, and the twist regarding Olympia is a total shock. If you like weird stories that mess with your mind, you should definitely give this a try. Since the visuals are so important for the mood, I suggest streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch all the details. If you prefer owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go for the best quality.
endingExplained: In the end, you find out that Olympia is not a real person, but a lifelike doll created by the Sandman. Daniel has been tricked into loving a machine. The Sandman reveals he has been manipulating Daniel's life since he was a kid to break his mind. Everything leads to a dark realization that Daniel cannot escape his past, and the movie closes with him trapped in a cycle of madness and loss.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark fairy tales and psychological twists.
